title: Plan 2 student loans: the interest and write-off rules, and the Student Loans Company and Department for Education figures the lifetime model reads
licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (gov.uk, Student Loans Company and Department for Education)

sources.name: Repaying your student loan: how much you repay (gov.uk)
sources.note: Read on the retrieved date. Gives the Plan 2 threshold of £29,385, the 9% rate and the Plan 2 interest bands: 4.1% at £29,385 or less, 4.1% plus up to 1.9% from £29,386 to £52,884, 6% at £52,885 or more.

sources.name: Repaying your student loan: when your student loan gets written off or cancelled (gov.uk)
sources.note: Plan 2 loans are written off 30 years after the April you were first due to repay.

sources.name: How interest is calculated: Plan 2 (gov.uk)
sources.note: The rate is set each 1 September from the previous March's RPI. Interest is added monthly. After the course the rate is RPI at or below the lower threshold (£29,385), RPI plus 3% at or above the higher threshold (£52,885), and RPI plus the same share of 3% as pay's share of the gap between them. Interest is capped at 6% between 1 September 2026 and 31 August 2027. Gives the worked example of £40,000, and earlier years' rates.

sources.name: Student Loans Interest Rates and Repayment Threshold Announcement, 10 August 2026 (gov.uk)
sources.note: RPI is 4.1% for 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027. Plan 2 interest varies between RPI (4.1%) and RPI plus 3% (7.1%); as announced on 7 April 2026 the maximum is capped at 6% between 1 September 2026 and 31 August 2027.

sources.name: Interest rate cap for Plan 2, Plan 5 and Postgraduate student loans (gov.uk)
sources.note: From 1 December 2023 the maximum Plan 2 rate is reviewed each month against the prevailing market rate, a 12-month rolling average of two Bank of England effective interest rate series for unsecured personal loans, and capped where it would be higher.

sources.name: Student loan forecasts for England: methodology (Department for Education, Explore education statistics)
sources.note: The Plan 2 threshold is £29,385 for 2026-27 and stays there until the end of 2029-30, following the freeze announced at the 2025 Autumn Budget, returning to RPI increases from April 2030. The lower interest threshold is the repayment threshold; the upper one was £49,130 until 2024-25 and £51,245 in 2025-26 after an RPI increase. The forecasts use OBR earnings growth and RPI forecasts.

sources.name: Student loan forecasts for England, financial year 2025-26 (Department for Education, Explore education statistics)
sources.note: The government is forecast to subsidise 39% of the Plan 2 full-time higher education loan outlay issued in 2025-26 (32% in the 2024-25 publication). Headline: of full-time undergraduate students starting in 2025/26, who are on Plan 5, 55% are expected to repay their loan in full. Table 2.2 as described on the page: full-time borrowers enter repayment with an average £48,100. The pages read do not state a salary at which a Plan 2 balance stops growing.

sources.name: Student loans in England: financial year 2025-26 (Student Loans Company, national statistics)
sources.note: Table 1A: balance sheet by plan, amounts in £ million, England and EU domiciled borrowers, at 31 March 2026. Table 5A (iii): average loan balance by repayment cohort, rounded to the nearest £10, at 30 April 2026. The 2025 cohort is the last before Plan 5 borrowers began entering repayment in April 2026; the 2026 figure is provisional.
